good-motion.notes: The clean pass: a gate that fails this is broken, and it is the only fixture that must satisfy both motion(idle) and responds(click).

good-static-noloop.notes: Deliberately still and correct: is_looping false is a declaration by the sketch, not a failed check, so the runner skips frame_advancing and still exits 0.

bad-missing-p5sound.notes: The missing-library bug: setup() throws, frameCount stays 0 while isLooping() is still true, and audio_context_running is null because with no p5.sound there is no getAudioContext to ask.

bad-audio-no-gesture.notes: The runtime-only bug from 2026-09-13: everything a reader can check passes and only the suspended AudioContext gives it away, which needs a secure-context origin (http://localhost or 127.0.0.1, not file:// and not a bare hostname) or p5.sound fails to load its worklet and the fixture tests the wrong thing.

bad-console-error.notes: A late failure, at frame 11: a gate that only reads the console at load time passes it, and the throw also stops frameCount while isLooping() stays true.

bad-frozen.notes: Running correctly on silence: every fixed check passes and only the motion(idle) frame-diff assertion catches it, which is why exit is 0 here.
